description: This Java class 'VariantUtil' defines constants and functions for manipulating variant binary data, including encoding/decoding variant values and metadata, handling different data types, and managing variant structure details within Apache Spark.

classes.name: VariantUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing constants and static methods for encoding, decoding, and manipulating variant binary data in Spark.

classes.name: VariantUtil.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of possible data types for variant values, including OBJECT, ARRAY, NULL, BOOLEAN, LONG, STRING, DOUBLE, DECIMAL, DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP_NTZ, FLOAT, BINARY, UUID.

methods.name: writeLong
methods.description: Writes the least significant 'numBytes' bytes of 'value' into 'bytes' array at position 'pos' in little-endian order.

methods.name: primitiveHeader
methods.description: Creates a header byte for primitive types with specified type.

methods.name: shortStrHeader
methods.description: Creates a header byte for short string type with specified size.

methods.name: objectHeader
methods.description: Creates a header byte for object type with size and id/offset sizes.

methods.name: arrayHeader
methods.description: Creates a header byte for array type with size and offset sizes.

methods.name: malformedVariant
methods.description: Returns a SparkRuntimeException indicating a malformed variant.

methods.name: unknownPrimitiveTypeInVariant
methods.description: Returns an exception for unknown primitive type ID in variant.

methods.name: variantConstructorSizeLimit
methods.description: Returns an exception when variant size exceeds limit.

methods.name: checkIndex
methods.description: Checks if position 'pos' is within array bounds; throws if out of bounds.

methods.name: readLong
methods.description: Reads a little-endian signed long value from byte array.

methods.name: readUnsigned
methods.description: Reads a little-endian unsigned int value from byte array, ensuring non-negativity.

methods.name: getTypeInfo
methods.description: Extracts type info bits from a variant value header byte.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the data type of a variant value based on its header byte.

methods.name: valueSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a variant value starting at position 'pos'.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Extracts a boolean value from variant data.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Extracts a long (or date/timestamp) value from variant data.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from variant data.

methods.name: checkDecimal
methods.description: Validates decimal precision and scale.

methods.name: getDecimalWithOriginalScale
methods.description: Extracts a decimal value with its original scale from variant data.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Extracts a decimal value, stripping trailing zeros.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Extracts a float value from variant data.

methods.name: getBinary
methods.description: Extracts binary data from variant.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Extracts string data from variant.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Extracts UUID from variant data.

methods.name: handleObject
methods.description: Helper to process object variant data with a handler.

methods.name: handleArray
methods.description: Helper to process array variant data with a handler.

methods.name: getMetadataKey
methods.description: Retrieves a string key from variant metadata by index.
